current.text: As a new user, I want to register and sign in with email+password or Sign in with Apple/Google so that my budget follows me across devices and is never lost with a phone. [goal-trace: enables sync reliability AC5 and retention AC2 | priority: P1 — gateway to every synced feature | rationale: email + the two dominant EU social logins cover the mainstream]
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when they register with email+password, then the password is stored argon2id-hashed and a verification email is sent
Given Sign in with Apple or Google whose verified email matches an existing account, when the user signs in, then the provider links to the same account instead of creating a duplicate

current.text: As a privacy-conscious new user, I want full core functionality without creating an account so that I can trust the app with real data before handing over any personal details. [goal-trace: entry-speed AC1 and D30 AC2 — no signup wall on the trial front door | priority: P1 | rationale: guest mode is the Free trial entry]
acceptance_criteria: Given a first launch, when the app opens, then a usable board is available with no signup step
Given local guest data, when the user creates an account later, then existing local data uploads without loss or duplication

current.text: Authentication security: the api hashes passwords with argon2id, issues short-lived JWT access tokens with rotating refresh tokens, and serves all traffic over TLS 1.3; secrets never appear in code or logs. Measure: CI secret-scan green plus the auth E2E suite green per release.

current.rule_text: IF a user is on the Free tier THEN manually-entered transactions are capped at 300 total, wallets at 3, and active synced devices at 1 (the previous device becomes read-only on a new sign-in). Source: product-owner decisions at the CR-001 grill interview 2026-07-08. Enforcement: hard.

crs.client_words: Budget Scout (codename) is the fastest, most satisfying way to track money by hand: a drag-and-drop coin interface for personal finances — offline-first, private, multi-currency including crypto — built for Europe.
crs.entry_point_advisory_rationale: First intake on an empty knowledge repo: goal.md-class prose describing a new product.
